name: Benchmark evaluation of classification methods for single label learning with R
description: An empirical evaluation suite comparing classification methods for single-label learning using R implementations across datasets to assess their performance.
reputation: An empirical benchmarking study comparing single-label classification methods implemented in R; historically useful to practitioners of classical ML but not widely used in modern LLM benchmarking.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focusing on classical classifiers in R; results can be implementation- and dataset-dependent, often involving relatively small or heterogeneous datasets and thus subject to dataset-size and contamination caveats.
